# criblio_mappings (Data Source)

Returns all matching objects in `items`, following API pagination automatically. Scope the request using the required attributes below. An empty collection returns an empty list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "criblio_mappings" "my_mappings" {
  product = "stream"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `product` (String) Name of the Cribl product that contains the Mapping Rulesets.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the Mapping Ruleset is active.
- `conf` (Attributes) Configuration for the Mapping Ruleset. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--conf))
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the Mapping Ruleset.

<a id="nestedatt--items--conf"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.conf`

Read-Only:

- `functions` (Attributes List) List of functions to pass data through. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--conf--functions))

<a id="nestedatt--items--conf--functions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.conf.functions`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Function type for the Mapping Rule.
- `filter` (String) Boolean filter expression used to determine whether the Mapping Rule applies. Evaluated against the Worker or Edge Node context.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Disable this Mapping Rule.
- `final` (Boolean) When a Mapping Rule matches, no further rules are evaluated for the Worker or Edge Node. This prevents multiple group assignments.
- `description` (String) Brief description of the function.
- `conf` (Attributes) Configuration for the Mapping Rule function. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--conf--functions--conf))
- `group_id` (String) The Worker Group to map matching events to.

<a id="nestedatt--items--conf--functions--conf"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.conf.functions.conf`

Read-Only:

- `add` (Attributes List) The group assignment action for the Mapping Rule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--conf--functions--conf--add))

<a id="nestedatt--items--conf--functions--conf--add"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.conf.functions.conf.add`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Assignment type for the Mapping Rule.
- `value` (String) The group to assign the Worker or Edge Node to when the Mapping Rule matches.
